open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    bg=4
    pat=[[5,5,5],[8,5,8],[8,5,0]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    for r,c in markers:
        for dr in range(3):
            for dc in range(3):
                rr,cc=r+dr-1,c+dc-1
                if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]): out[rr][cc]=pat[dr][dc]
    return out
''')
